continuity_contract.current_milestone: Clear the fixed ContextBench contract through frozen evidence-led rounds while keeping ContextBench diagnostics distinct from semantic retention and repair correctness.
continuity_contract.enduring_objective: Improve reusable ARE reasoning, useful continuity, recovery, correctness and completed outcomes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
continuity_contract.initial_objective: Finish GLM-5.3-flash qualification, beginning with small context windows and useful reasoning-state recovery under pressure.
continuity_contract.research_method: objective → gap → question → competing hypotheses → selection → experiment/tasks/criteria → results → observations → reviewed decision → successor

dataset_refs: same exposed eight-task cohort; earlier identities remain immutable
experiment_template.research_question: Does zero-token pinned-base effect closure clear the fixed 8K development gate without stochastic branch noise?
stop_conditions: Each Round 29 identity runs once; failures remain zero in both outcomes.
No threshold, task, source, prompt, cap, scorer, identity, or closure-policy change after freeze.
Pass advances to untouched confirmation; failure returns to competing hypotheses.

records.falsifier: Scheduled Span-F1 gain is below +0.05, File-F1 or validity degrades, any closure evidence is not receipt-bound pinned-base effect overlap, any export fails, unknown usage appears, or closure adds a model call or token.
records.mechanism: After a terminal response validates, preserve its model-selected IDs as baseline; rank delivered pinned-base observations by changed-range overlap then width, take at most six, and deterministically union them as treatment. Score both selections from the identical response.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; same-trajectory useful continuity within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: A six-item, zero-model-token completion closure over receipt-bound pinned-base observations overlapping actual effects improves GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench Span-F1 by at least 0.05 on the same model trajectories without degrading File-F1 or validity.

records.claim: On 24 frozen same-trajectory GLM-5.3-flash 8K development rows, six-item pinned-base effect closure improved scheduled macro Span-F1 by 0.085019 and File-F1 by 0.040278, added one valid selection, and added zero model calls or model tokens.
limitations: Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness or semantic retention.
This is exposed 8K development evidence, not untouched confirmation or full ContextBench clearance.
Three JavaScript branches were fixed zeros after the shared prefix terminated early.
Transfer to the 233 reserved identities, 10K/12K windows, other models, and other domains remains untested.

records.next_action: Freeze the unchanged six-item same-trajectory mechanism for the untouched reserved confirmation cohort. Run 8K primary-tier confirmation first, retain all missing and failed identities, and do not tune on confirmation outcomes.
